Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Canada EST.

As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own your product’s roadmap, collateral, and market research, and you will collaborate with Grafana leadership on fine-tuning your product’s goals.

You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
Product Managers are the bridge that connect Engineering, Design, and UX to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.

As the Staff Product Manager for OpenTelemetry Experience, you’ll own the end-to-end journey for helping people and agents instrument workloads and successfully send useful OpenTelemetry data to Grafana Cloud.
Your mission is to make Grafana Cloud the easiest and most trusted destination for OpenTelemetry workloads. You’ll reduce the uncertainty, complexity, and failure points users encounter between deciding to adopt OpenTelemetry and receiving healthy, correctly attributed, and actionable telemetry in Grafana Cloud.
Teams can instrument workloads, directly or with the help of coding agents, through OpenTelemetry SDKs, automatic instrumentation technologies such as Beyla and SDK injection, or client-side OpenTelemetry Collectors. Each path presents different decisions, deployment requirements, configuration steps, and potential failure modes.

You’ll define a coherent experience that helps users choose the right approach, complete setup successfully, troubleshoot problems, and understand whether their telemetry is healthy and useful. You’ll design a future in which a growing share of instrumentation work is performed by coding agents acting on behalf of developers.

This means treating agents are first-class participants in the experience and ensuring that instrumentation options, configuration requirements, errors, and validation signals are structured, discoverable, and actionable by both humans and machines.

OpenTelemetry SDK onboarding and configuration
Automatic instrumentation experiences, including OBI/Beyla and SDK injection
Client-side OpenTelemetry Collector deployment and onboarding
Collector configuration, authentication, and initial connectivity
Guidance and machine-readable context that help people and agents choose the right instrumentation approach
Workflows that allow coding-agents to implement, configure and verify instrumentation safely
Troubleshooting missing, incomplete, malformed, or unhealthy telemetry
Validation signals that allow both people and agents to confirm that telemetry is healthy, correctly attributed, and usable in Grafana Cloud
The transition from receiving telemetry to activating the appropriate Grafana Cloud observability solution
Success does not stop when Grafana Cloud receives the first data point. Telemetry must arrive with the quality, context, and structure required to support meaningful observability outcomes. You’ll partner closely with teams responsible for experiences such as Application Observability, Kubernetes Monitoring, Infrastructure Observability, and Drilldown Apps to ensure OpenTelemetry workloads receive a first-class experience from initial setup through first value.
This is a horizontal Staff-level product leadership role spanning multiple products and engineering teams. You may not directly own every SDK, collector, instrumentation technology, or downstream application involved in the journey. You will, however, be accountable for the coherence of the overall customer experience, its success measures, and the cross-product strategy required to improve it.
AI will also be part of how you work, not only what you build. You’ll be expected to use AI tools regularly to accelerate customer-research synthesis, analyze product signals, explore technical workflows, prototype experiences, develop positioning content, and test agent-led instrumentation journeys. You’ll model thoughtful, hands-on adoption of AI while applying strong judgement to its outputs.
The role is not focused on developing OpenTelemetry as an open source project in isolation. You’ll engage with and contribute to the OpenTelemetry ecosystem where appropriate, while measuring success through customer activation and outcomes in Grafana Cloud.

Define the vision, strategy, and cross-product roadmap for the journey from an uninstrumented workload to healthy, useful telemetry in Grafana Cloud solutions
Create coherent, opinionated experiences that help users choose and implement the right approach across SDK instrumentation, automatic instrumentation, and Collector-based deployment while preserving the flexibility advanced users require
Identify and eliminate the leading causes of setup failure, abandonment, misconfiguration, and low-quality telemetry
Establish shared experience principles, priorities, and success criteria across the product and engineering teams contributing to the OpenTelemetry journey
Use customer research, product data, and market insight to prioritize investments and measure outcomes such as onboarding completion, time to useful telemetry, telemetry health, and workload expansion
Partner with downstream Grafana Cloud solution teams to create a coherent transition from telemetry ingestion to meaningful product activation

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

Named #1 best software for small business of 2024 by G2
2,700+ employees in the United States, Canada, Mexico, and Turkiye and growing
Over $500M in annual revenue
The SMB market is large (and growing!) with huge opportunities for Gusto to make an incredible impact for SMBs
There are 6.2M employers in the US, 98% have fewer than 100 employees (1)
550,000 new businesses are created each year in the US (1)

s.h: What Product Management is like at Gusto
s.t:
Our Product team is lean, which means you’ll have a high degree of impact and ownership. We believe in smaller, empowered teams that move quickly with less overhead. You’ll move fast by pairing sharp product judgment with fluency in AI tools automating what slows teams down and amplifying what makes them creative and high-performing.
We’re boundaryless builders. Lines between roles are intentionally blurred, and our PMs do whatever it takes to deliver outcomes. You’ll prototype, automate, design, and ship using AI as your co-builder to turn problems into durable solutions that deliver customer value with urgency and care.
We’re here to serve small and medium businesses. Gusto has a strong mission-driven culture, and we care deeply about lifting up these business owners building technology for an AI-first world that gives them the superpowers to run and grow their businesses with confidence.
We’re comfortable with change. Our environment moves fast, and PMs here thrive in ambiguity blending curiosity, experimentation, and AI-native craft to shape how products (and work itself) are built at Gusto.

CoreX AI builds and powers AI experiences that make Gusto the best teammate for small businesses. Our largest AI bets embed directly in small business workflows whether that's answering a quick question or handling the task itself. Our customers trust us with their payroll, their employees' benefits, and their money decisions where mistakes have real, immediate consequences. We give small businesses trusted and powerful AI tools that supercharge how they work.
We're at an inflection point across everything we own, and we're looking for a product leader ready to accelerate our AI bets as we build toward that future. This is a role for builders who can work across Gusto, reason about API design and model behavior as comfortably as customer experience, and bring hands-on experience building with AI.

You'll define how Gusto's conversational assistant works, behaves, and earns customer trust and how small businesses use it to get real work done across payroll, benefits, HR, and beyond.
Develop a deep understanding of how small businesses actually work inside Gusto today the workflows they run, where they get stuck, and the work they'd hand off if they could
Lead the product vision for Gusto’s conversational assistant that gives small businesses superpowers, and turn it into a coherent strategy a sharp perspective on where the assistant earns real value, and what we build first
Expand what the assistant can actually do. You'll partner with domain teams to grow tool and domain coverage across payroll, time, benefits, and compliance, and hold the bar on quality as coverage grows measured in real actions customers complete, not conversations they have
Define how we show up in our customers’ ecosystem and the surfaces where work naturally happens third-party connectors, messaging channels, and AI clients and decide what earns priority against the depth we have in the app
Partner with engineering and data teams on technical trade-offs: how we expose Gusto's capabilities to agents through our API and MCP layer, how the assistant embeds into our first-party surfaces, and where we take on debt to move faster
Partner with design and UXR to understand how customers actually feel about AI acting on their behalf, and use that to shape how we build
Move fast. Speed is our top priority, and you'll set a pace that reflects it shipping narrow slices that get customers value early rather than waiting on the complete build

10+ years building as a product manager, with experience owning meaningful scope and driving broad product or platform-level decisions
You're comfortable in a high-visibility role engaging directly with Gusto leadership and product leaders across the company, and driving decisions that stick
You believe in what AI can do for small businesses, and you're excited to build it.
You understand what it takes to build trusted AI products: writing evals, holding a real point of view on AI quality, and assuming the responsibility of a product customers rely on day-to-day
You're hands-on and you'd rather build than delegate — and you thrive in a culture that expects it
You’re comfortable spanning both platform thinking and UX/experience judgment within the same role
You develop sharp perspectives on the systems AI products need — RAG, ontology, and a scalable API strategy for agent-accessible systems
You’re comfortable with a fluid, expanding charter. This isn't a role with a static roadmap, given how fast AI development and the competitive landscape are moving.
Our cash compensation amount for this role is $179,000,000/yr to $220,000/yr in Denver & most major metro locations, and $210,000/yr to $260,000/yr for San Francisco, Seattle & New York. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, experience, and expertise, and may vary from the amounts listed above.
Gusto has physical office spaces in Denver, San Francisco, and New York City. Employees who are based in those locations will be expected to work from the office on designated days approximately 2-3 days per week (or more depending on role). The same office expectations apply to all Symmetry roles, Gusto's subsidiary, whose physical office is in Scottsdale.
Note: The San Francisco office expectations encompass both the San Francisco and San Jose metro areas.
When approved to work from a location other than a Gusto office, a secure, reliable, and consistent internet connection is required. This includes non-office days for hybrid employees.
Our customers come from all walks of life and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. If you share our values and our enthusiasm for small businesses, you will find a home at Gusto.

HelloFresh serves millions of customers weekly across 18 business units and 8 brands worldwide. At the heart of our product is a belief that every customer deserves a menu that feels like it was made for them, the right meals, at the right time, for the right person. We call it the Sous Chef vision.
As Senior PM II on the Personalization Experience team , you own what makes that vision real and felt . You're not building the ranking algorithm, you're building the experiences that make customers trust it, the data collection that makes it smart, and the moments where someone thinks: this app actually knows me .
This is a high-autonomy role at the intersection of consumer UX, engineering, and ML systems. The problems are genuinely hard, the scale is real, and the decisions are yours to make.

Food Profile Quality & Signal Collection: The food profile is the raw material that powers everything downstream. Your job is to move customers from "fields filled in" to truly Personalization-Ready: high-signal, validated, actionable. You'll own and iterate on the collection experiences that give our models the data they need to perform.
The "Sous Chef" Feel & Transparency: You build the moments where personalization becomes tangible, the places where we tell customers why certain meals were chosen for them. This isn't just UX work, it's trust infrastructure for the entire personalization stack.
Cross-Org Data Supplier : You're the clean, reliable interface between raw signal and downstream experience, owning the explanation payloads and API contracts that make it all work at scale. You operate across organizational boundaries and align on shared metrics without needing to own the surfaces.
AI-Native Discovery You use GenAI tools actively to compress discovery-to-decision cycles, synthesizing global customer signals, stress-testing hypotheses, and arriving at decision-ready specs faster than traditional PM workflows allow. You don't treat AI as a novelty; it's a genuine speed and quality multiplier in your daily practice.
Long-Horizon Strategy You manage your domain with real autonomy. You run a flywheel: better profile data → better models → more visible personalization → more signal back to personalization. You own the strategy and sequencing, not just the backlog, thinking 12–18 months out and making the calls that shape the direction of the team.

Deep personalization or data-collection PM experience. 5+ years of PM experience, with meaningful time on user-facing personalization or data collection products, ideally where the UX is the data pipeline, and where you've shipped for both end customers and downstream data consumers.
Strong product taste and customer-facing craft. You have a genuine feel for what makes a consumer experience compelling, trustworthy, and sticky, not just functional. You've built products at scale where millions of people interact with what you ship, and you hold a high bar for the details: the copy, the interaction pattern, the moment of delight. You know the difference between a feature that works and one that earns trust.
Data-native. You query your own data (SQL/Python), define your own input/output KPIs, and hold your own in deep-dive technical discussions without needing a data analyst to translate.
Cross-org credibility. You've shipped products across organizational boundaries, aligning on shared metrics, maintaining clean contracts with engineering partners, and navigating competing priorities without direct authority.
Experimentation with healthy skepticism. You design experiments to validate hypotheses and know how to interpret results without over-indexing on noise. You've made hard calls to kill features based on data.
Exceptional communicator. You can make a complex algorithmic concept legible to a non-technical VP and you can write a spec that engineers can actually ship from.
The AI edge. You've already incorporated AI-assisted workflows into your daily practice to increase speed, depth of insight, and output quality.

Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience.

From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste.

While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

s.h: About the role: What's in the Box
s.t:
As HelloFresh scales globally, our Supply Chain Technology team is expanding to solve unique, high-stakes logistics challenges. In this role, you will lead our Shipping and Tracking Squad, taking ownership of scalable products that directly impact how millions of meal kits move through our logistics network and reach customer doorsteps.

You will collaborate closely with engineering tribes and operational leaders across all HelloFresh markets to optimize existing shipping capabilities and build innovative 0-to-1 solutions.
At HelloTech, flexibility and cross-functional collaboration are core to how we work. While this role is aligned to a specific Alliance, strong candidates may also be considered for opportunities across different teams or projects.
Work with HelloFresh in Warsaw and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience.

From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste.

While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

Define and execute a clear mid-term vision for your domain, driving step-change improvements across logistics network design, execution, and shipping operations.
Collaborate with a cross-functional tribe of engineers, product managers, and operational stakeholders across global markets.
Serve as the domain SME, mastering complex logistics challenges and ensuring our product suite delivers high usability and operational value.
Take a data-driven approach to deep-dive analytics, continuously evaluating, measuring, and optimizing product feature performance.
Drive end-user testing and change management to facilitate smooth feature rollouts across global operations.
Foster a customer-obsessed culture focused on delivering the highest quality delivery experience to HelloFresh customers.

Strong senior/lead level of product management experience, preferably within e-commerce, logistics, or food tech environments.
Proven track record of solving complex operational challenges in large, multi-country environments by optimizing products and launching 0-to-1 innovations.
Strong analytical expertise paired with business acumen, capable of translating raw data into clear, actionable strategies.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to distill complex technical topics for diverse audiences.
Adaptable, growth-oriented mindset with a passion for building simple, scalable, and sustainable solutions.
Above all, we are looking for individuals who will make HelloFresh better. We believe there are many different ways of developing skills and we love diverse experiences! So even if you don’t “tick all the boxes” but think you’d thrive in this role, we would really like to learn more about you.

HelloFresh's Onboarding squad owns the highest-leverage window in the customer lifecycle: from the moment a prospect converts to the moment they become a settled, loyal customer. Onboarding is the connective tissue that links the conversion funnel to long-term customer value.
We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead the Onboarding squad and define the product vision for how HelloFresh guides new customers from their first delivery into habitual, high-value subscription. You will own the end-to-end early customer experience across web and app — spanning post-checkout confirmation, subscription management, digital engagement, and the critical Box 1→2→3 progression — across all HelloFresh Group brands, including Factor.
The defining product challenge ahead is building and scaling the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: an ML-powered, segment-aware system that identifies the right action for each customer at each moment in their early lifecycle and delivers it seamlessly across web and app surfaces. This is a genuine 0-to-1 build — one that requires both strategic vision and hands-on execution.
This role demands a PM who is obsessed with solving customer pain points and equally obsessed with the cross-squad collaboration required to do it at scale. Onboarding does not sit inside a single product surface — it spans the activation funnel, CRM and lifecycle communications, app and engagement experiences, and Data Science.

The PM leading this squad must be a hyper-collaborator: capable of aligning diverse stakeholders across squads and tribes and bringing coherence to an experience that crosses many surfaces and teams.

Own the product vision and strategy for the end-to-end Onboarding experience across all HelloFresh Group brands — from post-checkout confirmation to Settled Conversion (3 boxes in 4 weeks).
Lead the build and scaling of the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: a segment-aware, state-aware personalisation system that dynamically surfaces the right customer action at the right moment across web and app.
Drive measurable improvement in Settled Conversion rate through a high-velocity experimentation roadmap.
Own the full-surface onboarding experience — welcome dashboard, subscription management, meal selection flows, app onboarding layer, and CRM-triggered touchpoints — ensuring coherence and quality across every channel and surface.
Partner with Data Science and Engineering to define the data and ML foundations that power personalised, segment-aware onboarding at scale.
Act as the connective tissue between squads and tribes: align the Activation funnel squad, CRM and Communications tribe, and App and Engagement team around a unified onboarding strategy and shared north-star metrics.
Build deep consumer empathy through qualitative research, quantitative funnel analysis, and direct customer engagement — and bring the early customer voice into every product decision.
Define and own success metrics for Onboarding — Settled Conversion rate, Box 1→2 and 2→3 conversion, app adoption rate, and unwanted box rate — and hold yourself and the squad accountable to them.
Own BAU operations: triage funnel issues rapidly, maintain onboarding health monitoring, and serve as the escalation point for anything threatening early retention performance.
Drive cross-functional alignment as a single-threaded leader across global tribes and alliances — creating clarity and shared direction needed for the squad to ship at velocity.

Customer Lifecycle & Early Retention Expertise: A deep understanding of subscription customer lifecycle dynamics — churn triggers, early retention levers, and the interplay between product experience and commercial outcomes. You think in journeys, not screens, and you can translate moments of friction or delight into business impact across the Box 0→3 window.
Cross-Surface Product Leadership: Proven experience owning end-to-end product experiences that span web and native app — including the architectural and strategic choices that come with maintaining coherence across channels. You understand how in-product engagement, push notifications, CRM communications, and app surfaces form a single connected customer journey.
Growth Experimentation at Scale: 6+ years of PM experience at Senior or Staff level, with hands-on expertise running structured growth experiments — A/B and multivariate testing, holdout groups — in consumer subscription products. You know how to design rigorous experiments, interpret results with nuance, and compound learnings into a strategic roadmap.
Hyper-Collaborative Leadership: Exceptional ability to operate across squad and tribe boundaries — aligning Engineering, CRM, Data Science, Design, and Marketing around a shared goal without direct authority. You create clarity in complexity and sustain alignment across a large, distributed organisation.
Data and ML Product Fluency: Comfortable partnering with Data Science to define and govern ML-powered personalisation systems. You do not need to write the models, but you can write the spec, challenge the approach, and translate model outputs into precise product decisions.
0-to-1 Build Pedigree: Proven experience taking complex, ambiguous product problems and turning them into shipped product at scale — from initial vision through delivery. You have led large-scale, end-to-end launches and know how to orchestrate cross-functional work under uncertainty.
Consumer Empathy & Insight-Driven Thinking: You combine qualitative empathy with quantitative rigour. You are as comfortable in a customer interview or usability session as in a funnel analytics deep-dive, and you consistently work backwards from user needs to define what to build.
High Agency & Ownership Mindset: You do not wait to be told what to do. You diagnose, decide, and drive. You are energised by ambiguity, take genuine accountability for outcomes rather than outputs, and raise the bar on the team around you.

Box Discount - Amazing discounts on 1 box per week! 75% discount on weekly HelloFresh and Chefs Plate meal kits AND 50% off weekly Factor meal box.
Health & Wellness - Health & Dental benefits from day 1, a Health Spending Account, unlimited access to the Headspace app to meet your self-care needs, and 25% discount on GoodLife fitness memberships!
Vacation & PTO - Time off is also an important part of self-care! We offer generous vacation and PTO to help you create a good work-life balance.
Family Benefits - A parental leave top-up program for expectant parents.
Growth & Development - We support your career progression and invest in your continued learning through experiences and initiatives owned by our dedicated L&D team
Work Hard & Have Fun - From team socials to engaging company days, you’ll have plenty of opportunity to experience the fun!
Diversity & Inclusion Initiatives - With impactful ERG’s like FreshPride, Women Empowered and LIMES, we are committed to our diversity, equity & inclusion efforts.
Flexible Hybrid Approach
At HelloFresh, we know that flexible work arrangements are essential in enabling you to do your best work, while balancing your personal and life needs. Offering remote work flexibility, along with the opportunity to interact and collaborate in the office are all a part of creating a great employee experience.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of the Lattice MCP (Model Context Protocol) server and the integrations that power Lattice AI.

This is the connective layer that lets customers use Lattice performance data inside the AI tools they already work in (Claude, ChatGPT, Glean, Microsoft Copilot, and Slack), and that brings third-party productivity data (e.g., Jira, GitHub, Linear, Zoom, Asana) into Lattice.

As AI becomes the center of gravity for how companies work, this surface is how Lattice stays connected, interoperable, and indispensable. You’ll join a fully staffed engineering team ready to execute, and together you’ll make ecosystem interoperability a reason customers choose and stay with Lattice.
If you enjoy solving complex problems, shaping platform strategy, and working with great internal and external partners, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for MCP & AI Ecosystem, you will:
Own the MCP and AI ecosystem strategy. Not only decide what features and integrations to pursue, but what MCP and AI mean to Lattice and our customers. Become a thought leader on how AI should shape HR for the better.
Ship integrations that create leverage. Deliver new MCP tools, resources, and third-party connectors that expand what admins, managers, and executives can do with Lattice data in the flow of work.
Build durable foundations, like authentication, agentic execution frameworks, and evals that make future integrations faster, more scalable, and easier to adopt and maintain.
Be a technical thought partner to Engineering. Help shape technical direction on MCP tool design and third party integration infrastructure, translating complex constraints into clear product decisions.
Drive go-to-market with partners. Partner with Partnerships, Product Marketing, to launch integrations that deliver measurable customer and ecosystem impact.
Own outcomes. Influence and own key results across integration and MCP adoption, reliability, activation, and ecosystem growth.
What You Will Bring to the Table
We’re looking for a seasoned product manager with the technical depth and strategic instincts to shape Lattice’s next generation of integrations and APIs. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:
7+ years of product management experience, with meaningful ownership of integrations, platform, or ecosystem surfaces (built end-to-end, not just configured).
Direct experience building technical integrations in a multi-party ecosystem — for example ad technology / marketing technology, marketplaces, developer platforms, payments, data connectivity, or similar — where partnership strategy shaped what you built.
Strong technical fluency: comfortable with third-party integration patterns, data sync and field mapping, webhooks, and auth/OAuth; you can hold a credible architecture conversation with engineers and partner CTOs.
A track record of shipping scalable, reliable integrations in partnership with engineering, and of standing up partner or marketplace launches with go-to-market teams.
Evidence of turning a platform or ecosystem into a competitive advantage — a reason customers chose your product, not just a checkbox.
Clear, confident communication that brings internal teams and external partners into alignment.
A bias for action and the ability to create structure in an ambiguous, fast-moving space.

Exposure to AI ecosystems, MCP, AI agents, or LLM tooling (helpful, not required).
Experience in multi-product B2B SaaS, or with HR/people-data or other sensitive-data workflows.
If you have strong experience with integrations, APIs, or platform products, even if you don’t meet every preferred qualification, we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for strong product thinkers with deep technical fluency, not perfect resumes.

At Lyft, our mission is to improve people's lives with the world's best transportation. To do this, we start with our own community by creating an open, inclusive, and diverse organization.
Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product.

Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry from our San Francisco and New York offices.
The Customer Care team is at the forefront of building intelligent AI agents that transform how Lyft delivers customer support. As AI capabilities evolve rapidly, we're moving beyond traditional automation to create AI agents that can understand complex customer needs, make intelligent decisions, and resolve issues with human-level quality.

This team works cross-functionally to design, deploy, and scale AI agents that handle real customer conversations and empower our human agents with more information to solve issues. They work alongside our support ops and insights teams to create exceptional experiences when our customers need help most.

Build and optimize AI agents that handle customer support interactions across chat and voice channels
Partner directly with engineering, data science, and ML teams to design agent capabilities and behaviors
Write, test, and refine prompt logic and conversation flows for specific customer use cases
Partner with support operations teams to understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities
Run rapid feedback loops between customer interactions and product development to continuously improve agent performance
Serve as the in-house expert on AI agent development, translating technical capabilities into business impact
Define success metrics and drive data-informed decisions to ensure optimal prioritization
Create an AI strategy that scales as Lyft grows

5+ years of experience in product management, with experience or familiarity with AI, ML, or conversational interfaces
Deep technical acumen—ability to understand and shape AI system designs, including prompt engineering and agent architectures
Experience leading a team of engineers and setting clear goals, strategies, and multi-quarter roadmaps
Comfortable working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape solutions as much as implement them

Customer obsession: You care deeply about delivering excellent support experiences and dive deep into the details of customer problems
Technical depth: You can engage credibly with engineers and understand AI/ML/LLM capabilities, limitations, and emerging developments
Collaboration: You excel at working across functions—engineering, design, operations, and executive teams—to drive aligned outcomes
Bias to action: You dive deep into complex problems, build elegant solutions, and move quickly to deploy them at scale
Analytics: You rely on experimentation and data to make decisions and measure real-world impact
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or equivalent technical experience strongly preferred
Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled

401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future

Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

We're building a new product team in India to help shape how customers build, deploy, and operate AI applications on MongoDB. This is an early hire on a growing team—you'll join while the team is still taking shape, with the opportunity to have real impact from the start.
You'll report to a Director of Product Management based in Europe, working async-first with partners across India, EMEA, and North America. The engineering team in India is being built in parallel, so you'll be working closely with engineers from the early days of the team.
We are looking to speak to candidates based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
What you'll own
You'll be the end-to-end owner for a core area of our AI application platform—from discovery and vision through roadmap, delivery, and iteration. This is a senior individual contributor role where you lead through ownership, expertise, and cross-functional influence.
Day to day, that means
Defining product strategy and roadmap for your area, aligned with MongoDB's broader AI strategy and business goals
Talking to customers — from AI-native startups to large enterprises — to understand how they build and deploy AI applications, where they struggle, and what MongoDB should do about it
Writing clear product narratives, memos, and specs that align stakeholders, clarify trade-offs, to guide conversations with engineering, design, product marketing, etc
Partnering with cross-functional stakeholders—including Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Partners, Sales, and Developer Relations—to scope, prioritize, and ship, balancing experimentation with reliability and scale, and driving positioning, launches, and enablement
Identifying new opportunities autonomously—spotting gaps, shaping problem spaces, researching industry trends and running discovery sessions with customers
Define and own clear success metrics for your area and use them to prioritize, make trade-offs and communicate impact
You'll develop deep expertise in how companies build AI applications — including agentic workflows, retrieval and memory, evaluation, observability, and deployment patterns.
How we work
Async-first. Documentation and written communication are how decisions travel across time zones
Sync when it makes sense. When we need to discuss something live, we hop on a call to unbundle issues together.
In-person when it matters. The team gets together periodically for planning, relationship-building, and the kind of work that's better done face to face

5+ years in product management (or equivalent) building platforms, infrastructure, or developer-facing products — ideally in cloud, data, or AI
Proven end-to-end ownership of a product area: from framing the problem and vision through roadmap, execution, launch, and iteration
Customer obsession: you're comfortable running discovery calls, digging into workflows, and turning messy feedback into clear product decisions
Strong written and live communication: clear docs, productive meetings, confident stakeholder presentations. This matters more in an async, distributed team — writing is how you lead
Technical depth sufficient to collaborate with senior engineers on distributed systems, cloud services, and AI/ML tooling, and to ask good questions when something is unclear
Curiosity about AI: you follow how companies are building AI applications — agents, orchestration frameworks, RAG, fine-tuning, or other emerging patterns
Comfort with ambiguity: you help define the problem, the success metrics, and the path forward. In an early-stage team, this is the job

Experience building developer tools, AI platforms, or MLOps/LLMOps products
Engineering background or deep experience partnering with engineering on technical products
Experience with enterprise customers on mission-critical workloads
Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Figma Make) to move faster and amplify impact
How we'll measure success (30/60/90 days)
We need someone who can onboard quickly and start driving impact early.

s.h: In your first 30 days, you will
s.t:
Ramp up on MongoDB products, AI application patterns, and how our teams work
Shadow customer calls and internal forums to learn current strategy, open questions, and key stakeholders
Produce a clear written overview of your product area: current state, key bets, and known gaps
By 60 days, you will
Take ownership of a set of customer relationships and run your own discovery conversations each week
Own and socialize an initial strategy and roadmap proposal for your area, with clear problem statements and success metrics
Partner with engineering and design to shape and drive at least one scoped initiative into execution
By 90 days, you will
Be the go-to owner for your product area, driving prioritization and day-to-day decision-making across functions
Lead customer- and data-informed iterations on what you’ve shipped, adjusting the roadmap based on what you’re learning
Contribute to the broader AI application platform strategy with perspectives from your domain, customers, and the field
Why this role
MongoDB is one of the most widely adopted database platforms in the world, used by tens of thousands of customers — including much of the Fortune 100 and a fast-growing set of AI-native startups. Our cloud platform, Atlas, runs across AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure.
This role puts you at the center of how MongoDB powers AI applications at scale. You’ll own a critical slice of that story, from strategy through delivery and adoption.
About MongoDB
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software.

MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI.

Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world!
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Senior Product Manager to own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of Revenue and Order to Cash (OTC) capabilities that enable accurate, scalable, and efficient revenue operations.
This role will work closely with the Group Product Manager, Quote to Cash (QTC), owning the OTC and revenue processes within the broader QTC organization, while partnering across Finance, Revenue Operations, Sales, Enterprise Architecture, Engineering, and Program Management to improve the end-to-end order-to-cash lifecycle — order management through billing, collections, revenue recognition, and close — and help the business scale with reliable, increasingly automated revenue systems.
You will own product discovery, prioritization, requirements, delivery partnership, and launch readiness across the OTC and revenue lifecycle — including order management, subscription and contract operations, billing, accounts receivable, collections, renewals, revenue recognition, month-end and quarter-end close, and ERP integrations.

The central focus of this role is revenue accuracy and timeliness: reducing manual adjustments, strengthening SOX and audit controls, accelerating time to invoice and cash, and building a foundation for continuous process improvement across the revenue lifecycle.

Define and maintain the Revenue/OTC product vision, strategy, roadmap, and release priorities in alignment with company objectives, with revenue accuracy and close efficiency as the north star
Partner closely with the Group Product Manager, QTC to align the OTC and revenue roadmap with the broader Quote to Cash strategy, while owning the order-to-cash and revenue processes as your dedicated area of focus
Build deep expertise in NetSuite and the surrounding revenue systems landscape, including billing, accounts receivable, revenue recognition, month-end and quarter-end close, order management, contract and subscription data, ERP integrations, and related Finance and GTM systems
Elicit, analyze, and document business and functional requirements across the OTC lifecycle; translate them into clear epics, user stories, acceptance criteria, and an actionable product backlog
Lead prioritization across competing Finance, Revenue Operations, and Sales needs, balancing near-term business value with long-term scalability and architectural health of revenue systems
Partner with Stakeholders, Lead PdM, Engineering, Architecture, TPM/Program Management, and implementation partners to evaluate and integrate strategic first- and third-party solutions for OTC and revenue processes
Define success metrics and KPIs for Revenue/OTC initiatives — such as billing accuracy, days sales outstanding (DSO), manual journal entry volume, and close cycle time — using data and stakeholder feedback to validate assumptions and measure post-launch outcomes
Own and improve end-to-end revenue workflows across order capture, billing, accounts receivable, collections, renewals, revenue recognition, month-end/quarter-end close, and reporting, including support for subscription and consumption-based business models
Provide product oversight for revenue controls, data definitions, business logic, integrations, and the overall consistency of the user experience across OTC systems
Coordinate integrated, cross-functional testing and partner with technology and business leads on release strategy, change management, training, and adoption for revenue system changes
Identify opportunities to improve revenue accuracy, accelerate time to invoice and cash, reduce billing leakage and manual journal entries, strengthen auditability and SOX compliance, simplify close processes, and maximize the return on investment of Revenue/OTC products
Communicate product decisions, tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and progress clearly to stakeholders and executive audiences, with particular fluency in revenue and close-related metrics

Required Experience and Skills
8+ years of relevant product management experience, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise business systems and influencing stakeholders at all levels
Strong experience with Order to Cash (OTC), Quote to Cash, or adjacent revenue and finance processes, with a clear emphasis on the order-to-cash and revenue recognition side of the lifecycle
Hands-on understanding of NetSuite-based billing and revenue operations, revenue recognition, accounts receivable, collections, month-end and quarter-end close, order management, subscription and contract data, and ERP or downstream revenue integrations
Strong NetSuite product and integration experience, with a solid understanding of Finance operations, revenue accounting, billing controls, SOX/audit requirements, and the upstream GTM processes that drive downstream revenue outcomes

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Director of People Technology, this role will serve as the Product Manager for Okta's People Technology portfolio, focused on Employee Growth & Talent. You will act as the strategic bridge between global People leaders and delivery teams.

You will translate strategic product visions into high-velocity execution — shaping the what and why in partnership with Digital Solutions and People leadership, and partnering with the Delivery Lead on the how and when — while navigating complex enterprise workflows across Talent Acquisition (Greenhouse), Learning & Development (Cornerstone), Talent Management (Workday), and AI-driven automation.

Global Stakeholder Management: Drive cross-functional alignment across Digital Solutions, distributed executive stakeholders, business functional leads, and US-based product counterparts to ensure clear visibility, smooth change management, and high program adoption.

8+ years of Product Management experience leading internal enterprise platforms, enterprise HR/Talent systems, or complex B2B SaaS products at global scale.

s.h: Role Overview: Product Manager, Product Platform
s.t:
This is a rare 0-to-1 opportunity to build a brand-new, high-visibility capability that touches every Okta customer: backup and recovery to strengthen the resilience of our system. You’ll be responsible for building a modern, self-service experience that allows IT Admins to recover back their accidentally or maliciously deleted identity objects.

You'll partner closely with Engineering, Field, Pricing & Packaging, and Product leadership to shape a capability with direct, measurable impact on customer retention and revenue growth.

Contribute to the long-term product vision and strategy for Okta's resilience strategy, ensuring the backup and recovery roadmap scales with the breadth of Okta's customer base and product portfolio.
Design a self-service recovery center to ensure customers can seamlessly and securely track their deletions and changes and revert back across the entire Okta ecosystem.
Collaborat e with India-based engineering and development scrum teams to deliver high-performance, scalable backup and recovery solution
Distill complex requirements from a diverse stakeholder group - including Field (AE/CSM), Pricing & Packaging, Support, Design, and Product teams - into precise technical specifications.
Analyze how large-scale enterprise customer’s resilience needs to identify friction points and drive improvements in customer trust and platform experience.
Validate assumptions at low cost by building compelling hypotheses and designing rigorous experiments before committing to major infrastructure investments.

3+ years of Product Management experience specifically within enterprise-scale SaaS platforms or core software infrastructure.
BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering , or equivalent technical experience that enables you to rationalize and influence complex architectural decisions.
Proven ability to produce solid, actionable plans from incomplete, conflicting, or highly ambiguous inputs.
Exceptional communication and presentation skills , with a track record of successfully collaborating across global functions and time zones.
Demonstrated business results from customer-facing platform capabilities shipped at scale.

Experience with Backup or recovery tools
Deep familiarity with Identity and Access Management (IAM) protocols and security standards.
Experience partnering with Sales/CSM organizations on customer-facing solution positioning
Advanced degree in a technical or business field (e.g., MS in a technical discipline or an MBA).
Location & Working Model
While this role offers location flexibility within India, it is a global-facing position. To bridge the gap between India-based and US-based teams, the candidate must be available for synchronous meetings between 9:00 AM and 11:00 AM Pacific Time , at least three days a week.

Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.
Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager, Hardware to help us discover, develop and deliver groundbreaking hardware products that our customers will love. The Senior Product Manager will be a driving force in delivering an unmatched product experience in close collaboration with a global, cross-functional team of world-class experts
This is a high-leverage product role where you’ll shape the very core of our product offering, directly impacting the business and customer experience.
This position requires flexibility for occasional travel and meetings outside regular working hours.

Product Ownership: take ownership of a hardware product to maximize company impact and customer satisfaction by solving customer and business pain points
Storytelling: Craft a unique product story rooted in deep customer insights.
Problem Solving: Proactively identify and resolve product-related issues throughout the product lifecycle.
Market & User Research: conduct market research, competitive analysis, and qualitative and quantitative user studies
Requirements Management: Write and manage product requirements (PRD), regularly assess progress, and facilitate timely decision making
Product Development Lifecycle: Support the entire product lifecycle from concept to end of life, working closely with engineering and design teams to ensure timely and high-quality execution
Prioritization: prioritize features, options, and product improvements - balancing cost, timeline, and experience tradeoffs
Communication: Effectively communicate priorities, plans, progress, and challenges to stakeholders across the organization. Maintain clear, organized communication.
Collaboration: Work closely with a diverse, talented team of designers, engineers, scientists, marketers, and analysts to create incredible products. Partner closely with software product management counterparts.
Roadmap support: contribute to the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Oura’s hardware product portfolio, including next-generation products.
Go-to-market: Support go-to-market readiness by developing compelling positioning and pricing and overseeing overall product readiness.

Outschool’s mission is to inspire kids to love learning. In our fast-changing world, the traditional educational system struggles to meet the diverse and evolving needs of young learners. Outschool reimagines this system, offering flexible and engaging learning experiences as a supplement and alternative to traditional education. By connecting learners with a global community of teachers and peers through our online platform, we make learning personal, dynamic, and deeply human.
We've made significant strides since launching our marketplace of live online classes in 2017. Finding initial success with secular homeschoolers, we then expanded to enrichment learning to meet the needs of a wider audience, growing our business 16x since 2019.

Post-pandemic, we have evolved our platform to power academic learning, incorporated AI, and have begun to grow our international community. We're proud to have served over 1.5M passionate learners with more than $100M in annual bookings.
Driving disruptive, positive change in education is rewarding and hard. Outschool team members are encouraged to challenge themselves, take risks, and grow in their careers. We look for talented people whose sense of urgency, innate curiosity, and determination to drive impact will help Outschool achieve outsized results in pursuit of our mission.

We invite you to be part of an ambitious team dedicated to ensuring every learner can navigate the future with curiosity, resilience, and a love of learning.

As a Product Manager at Outschool, you’ll build products that shape how millions of learners, families, and educators experience education. You’ll tackle complex, high-impact problems across our consumer marketplace and our growing ESA (Education Savings Account) business, where we’re helping families use education funds to access high-quality learning opportunities.
You’ll work closely with engineering, design, data, marketing, operations, and other teams to identify the biggest opportunities, set product strategy, and turn ideas into simple, impactful experiences.
We’re hiring across levels - from early-career PMs through product leaders - and will scope the role based on your experience, strengths, and the problems where you can have the greatest impact.
Your work might span the learner, parent, educator, or marketplace experience, from helping families discover the right classes, to building tools that enable educators to thrive, to creating new experiences for ESA families and strengthening the systems that power our marketplace.

Identify the most important near- and long-term product opportunities and translate them into clear strategies, roadmaps, and priorities.
Own products end-to-end—from discovery and strategy through execution, launch, experimentation, and iteration.
Develop a deep understanding of our customers and marketplace through research, data, and direct customer insight.
Partner with engineering, design, data, and cross-functional teams to turn ambiguous problems into elegant, scalable solutions.
Define success metrics, design experiments, analyze results, and use quantitative and qualitative insights to drive decisions.
Build alignment around product vision, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and keep teams moving toward meaningful outcomes.
Understand Outschool’s strategic and competitive position and build products that differentiate us in the market.
Help foster a product culture grounded in customer empathy, experimentation, learning, and measurable impact.

Professional product management experience; level will be determined based on experience and scope.
Experience working closely with engineering, design, data, and other cross-functional partners and having a track record of taking ownership, navigating ambiguity, and delivering meaningful outcomes.
Experience owning the full product lifecycle, from identifying opportunities and defining strategy to launch and iteration.
Strong product sense and the ability to identify the problems that matter most.
Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to use data to inform decisions and measure impact.
Strong quantitative skills, including the ability to define experiments and analyze results
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clarity and alignment across teams.
For more senior candidates, we’ll also look for experience setting product strategy, influencing across an organization, mentoring other PMs, and driving impact through complex, highly ambiguous problems.

Experience in EdTech or building products for learners, educators, or families
Familiarity with search, discovery, personalization, AI, tooling, data insights, and/or payment products
Background in marketplace technologies
Experience at a fast-paced startup or high-growth company

As the ideal candidate, you will have a deep understanding of connected fitness and the ability to operate at the intersection of hardware, software, and content, making critical product decisions that balance user needs, technical feasibility, and business goals.

Define the long-term vision and roadmap for the Peloton portfolio, ensuring it aligns with our broader business goals and anticipates future user needs
Oversee the entire product lifecycle, from initial concept to launch and post-launch analysis. Define and track key performance metrics to measure product success and identify areas for future improvement

A strong history of success leading highly cross-functional projects from concept to launch. You are skilled at communicating with and influencing diverse stakeholders, from design and marketing to engineering and operations
Deep understanding of the hardware development process, including manufacturing, supply chain, and quality assurance
Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a proven ability to influence and collaborate across all levels of the organization

Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.

The mission of the Foundation AI group is to enable Roblox Creators to accelerate their workflows and to put GenAI in the hands of millions of users. We envision a future in which experiences on Roblox leverage generative text and speech capabilities to enable new forms of interaction, generative 3D and 4D capabilities to enable new ways to create, and generative video to give creators a level of visual fidelity and motion that has never been available at this scale.
We shipped our 3D foundation model, which takes text prompts as input and generates production ready 3D objects and worlds.

We are now building the Roblox Video Model; the Super Upsampler at the heart of Roblox Reality, our hybrid architecture that pairs the structured simulation of the Roblox Game Engine and Roblox Cloud with the photorealism of Video World Models.

The engine stays the source of truth for the data model: state, physics, collision, logic, and multiplayer consistency. The video model generates the pixels: higher fidelity textures, realistic lighting, secondary motion, fluid dynamics, and the unscripted detail of a real world.

A world model paired with our engine, enables persistent, multiplayer, photorealistic worlds that any creator can build and any player can join.
As the Senior/Principal Product Manager for Video Generation, your job is to put that in the hands of our community. You will take the Roblox Video Model out of the lab and into creator early access, then to a platform capability available to everyone, running on cloud edge GPU infrastructure, scaling toward tens of millions of concurrents, and keeping agency firmly with the creator. You will own the strategy and vision, define how creators direct and control the model.

Build a vision and strategy for real-time video generation that delights creators and players and leads to industry-defining innovation in world models.
Own the launch to our community — from lab demo, to creator early access, to scaled platform capability — and earn the trust of a community with real concerns about AI in creation by shipping in the open and proving the model serves them.
Define the creator control surface: how creators condition, direct, and constrain the model so their game rules, art direction, and systems are never overridden.
Deeply understand the model capabilities our creators need — temporal coherence, multiplayer consistency, avatar fidelity, prompt and style adherence — and shape the research roadmap against them.
Develop comprehensive evaluation for our models, combining automated metrics with creator and player feedback, and own the quality, latency, and cost curve with research and infrastructure so this scales affordably.
Work across the company — with engine, rendering, creator, safety, and economy — to make generated pixels safe, age-appropriate, and a core part of gameplay.
Manage from vision through the product life cycle, prioritizing by working with creators and analyzing how our model is used, while providing insights to non-technical audiences and holding your own with world-class AI researchers.

This is a defining opportunity for a Senior Product Manager to own how every Samsara device comes to life.
Samsara ships hundreds of thousands of devices a year to fleets, construction sites, and depots worldwide. A single customer rollout can exceed 50,000 devices , where every minute saved per install compounds into weeks of deployment time. Each device has a five-minute window where it goes from a box in someone's hands to a live sensor feeding a customer's operation. You will own those five minutes and the multi-year vision for what they become.
The install experience is critical to the compounding value of every Samsara product. A camera aimed correctly on day one trains better safety models. A gateway reporting cleanly makes every downstream workflow trustworthy.
You will own the software install experience end to end, with a dedicated engineering and design team, and you will own one number: install correctness , the share of installs completed right on the first attempt.

Correctness today swings by several points depending on whether the installer uses the Samsara Fleet App, and closing that gap for every install is the first prize. Your target is an install under five minutes of active app time that confirms its own health before the installer walks away.
You are building for two people who each get the same five minutes. A contracted technician on their twentieth install of the day wants speed. A customer's shop mechanic on their first wants guidance that assumes nothing. Both are standing in a truck bay, holding a phone, sometimes without signal.
To understand the scale of this problem, review the Samsara Vehicle Gateway here , our full hardware lineup here , and our installer partner network here .
This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

Own the three-year vision for device installation and provisioning , defining how Samsara hardware comes online as the platform expands across new products, device types, and geographies.
Own install correctness. Set the target, instrument the funnel so every outcome is attributable, and move the number quarter over quarter.
Own the guided install and verification flow in the Samsara Fleet app, for professional installers and for customers who install hardware themselves.
Build the intelligence that verifies an install is correct , checking camera aim, wiring, and signal quality while the installer is still standing at the vehicle.
Give operations leaders a live view of fleet readiness: what is installed, what is verified, and what is producing data.
Ride along on installs and run sessions in customer yards , then turn what you observe into roadmap that shapes hardware, firmware, and software decisions.
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles as we scale globally.

Technical depth sufficient for engineers to treat you as a peer: a degree in Computer Science or Engineering, prior experience as an engineer, or demonstrated fluency in system architecture trade-offs.
Proven ability to operate at both altitudes, setting multi-year direction and reviewing the details of a screen flow in the same week.
Executive-level communication and presence, comfortable presenting and defending strategy to the CEO, CPO, and customers.

Experience instrumenting a funnel and running experiments against it.

Twilio is looking for a Senior Principal, Product Management to deliver our strategic vision for the Developer Platform . You will manage foundational services, APIs, and infrastructure, driving the roadmap that empowers internal teams and partners to scale confidently.
You will treat the platform as a product , shifting platform engineering from reactive, ad-hoc support into proactive, self-service experiences. Grounded in industry research (DORA, CNCF, Team Topologies, etc..), you will introduce golden paths, a discoverable developer portal, self-service tools, and high-quality documentation to reduce cognitive load and support burdens across Twilio.
Collaborating with product leaders, engineering, architecture, and design, you will define the future of developer experience, tooling, deployment, and operational capabilities, acting as the steward for evangelizing our developer platform capabilities and narrative and driving roadmap prioritization across a scalable cloud platform.
Key Skills
Platform-as-a-Product Expertise: Proficiency in applying product management methodologies—including user research, roadmapping, and KPI definition—to internal infrastructure.
Architectural & Technical Fluency: Deep understanding of cloud-native technologies (Kubernetes, microservices, CI/CD) and observability frameworks, enabling credible engagement with engineering leads.
Developer Experience Design: Proven ability to identify developer friction points and architect solutions like developer portals, golden paths, and documentation-as-code to drive self-service.
Stakeholder Influence & Evangelism: Capacity to build compelling narratives that align cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, Security) and drive internal platform adoption.
Performance Analytics: Experience defining and using success metrics (DORA, adoption, reliability) to advocate for data-driven product strategies.

Own the Platform Roadmap: Define and drive the multi-quarter strategy for foundational services, ensuring the roadmap balances technical debt, scalability, and new feature velocity.
Transition to Self-Service: Actively shift the platform from reactive, 'ticket-based' support to a scalable, proactive product model by establishing paved roads and service catalogs.
Lead Cross-functional Integration: Partner with Engineering, Architecture, and Security leads to ensure platform solutions are extensible, compliant, and meet the unique needs of internal developers.
Drive Developer Productivity: Champion continuous improvements in APIs, SDKs, and sandbox environments to reduce time-to-first-deploy and cognitive load.
Measure and Optimize: Establish governance frameworks and KPI dashboards to track adoption, support deflection, and reliability, iteratively refining the platform based on usage data and developer feedback.
Customer focus: Deeply understand customer needs and advocate for customer-centric product & engineering practices, using developer interviews and usage data to translate requests into root causes.
Stakeholder Alignment: Act as the voice of the Twilio platform across the organization (internal development platform, deployment systems, developer experience and tooling, etc.), ensuring stakeholder needs are well understood and incorporated into the product planning process.

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company. We free people and agents to ship what’s next.
For more than a decade, Vercel has shaped how the web is built. As the team behind Next.js, v0, and AI SDK, we create products that help builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.
Now, software is entering a new era, and the next generation of products will not just be used by people. They will be built, extended, and operated by agents.
We are building the platform for that future, trusted by companies like OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide . Whether you’re building our products, supporting our customers, growing our community, or shaping our story, you’ll help define what comes next.

We are looking for a Product Manager, Observability to join our Product team. You will own the strategy and roadmap for Vercel's observability products, including Runtime Logs, OpenTelemetry tracing, and Drains, which let teams stream logs, traces, Web Analytics events, and Speed Insights metrics into the systems they already use.

You will partner closely with engineering and design to help customers understand and debug what they run on Vercel, both through Vercel's native surfaces and through integrations with vendors that support OpenTelemetry. You will report to the product lead and will be located in New York, NY (hybrid).
If you’re based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday. If you're located beyond that distance, the role is fully remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

Own strategy and roadmap for Vercel's observability products, from telemetry ingestion through the surfaces developers use to debug and monitor.
Turn ambiguous signal — support escalations, customer interviews, usage data, competitive shifts — into a sequenced plan with clear tradeoffs.
Partner daily with engineering on scoping, and with design on making dense telemetry data genuinely legible.
Define the native-vs-integrate line: what Vercel builds, and where we make Datadog, Sentry, Grafana, Honeycomb, and New Relic work seamlessly.
Work with Enterprise customers and Sales/Solutions on observability needs that block adoption or expansion.
Own pricing and packaging decisions with Finance and GTM — observability is metered, and unit economics are part of the product.
Write the launch narrative: changelogs, blog posts, docs direction, in partnership with PMM
Define the metrics that tell you it's working, and hold the team to them.

5+ years in product management, with meaningful time on developer, infrastructure, or data-intensive products.
You've shipped something technical enough that engineers treated you as a peer. You can read a trace waterfall and reason about cardinality, sampling, and retention costs.
Comfortable owning a domain end to end without a PM above you translating strategy into work.
You use the products you build on, and you have opinions about the ones you don't.
Fluency with data: you write your own queries and don't wait on someone else to answer a usage question.
